question: Which epithets present Gaṇeśa as universal maker, invincible, and victorious?
premises: Gaṇeśa is called the maker of all.
Gaṇeśa is described as all-faced and hard to conquer.
Gaṇeśa is named conqueror of burdens and victory itself.
inference: These names attribute universal creative power, invincibility, and triumphant mastery to Gaṇeśa.
plain_english: He is the maker of all, all-faced, hard to conquer, conqueror of burdens, and victory itself.
